title: Campus – Hokkaido University

excerpts.text:
Hokkaido University’s main campus is located in Sapporo, the capital of Hokkaido. The Faculty of Fisheries Sciences is based in Hakodate, in the southern part of the island. In addition to these campuses, Hokkaido University operates numerous research forests, experimental farms, and aquatic research stations both within and outside Hokkaido.
